admission.justification: The forged-span and delayed-restore cases guard selecting another comparison or replacing a choice the reader has already made.

applicability: URL selection storage and reload restoration on the review page.
conditions: Use history.replaceState for block, subject-with-family, lane-file/lane-row and hunk selections; include comparison only when an older number is shown.
Validate entries against the card read identity, subjects/family against the outline/catalogue, files against the lane and hunks against both code trees and exact classified mapped spans.
Wait for the needed owner reads; an unreadable, malformed or outside selection opens unselected with one named line.
A new explicit selection supersedes an outstanding restore, so a late answer changes neither selection nor URL and arms no landing.
A latest-comparison entry selection reads its owning invariant once; lane selections and older comparisons do not issue subject reads.
exclusions: Guessing a selection from a catalogue answer.
Accepting a hunk solely because its path and code trees exist.
Restoring a prior read over a newer user selection.
